mapper.sql: select id, back_number, schedule_item_id, show_img, index_order, all_score, avg_score, rank_order, match_id, works_music_name, team_id, game_item_id, sport_limit, works_name, works_music, works_video, create_time, update_time from jw_sign_record
mapper.select: select a.id, a.team_id, a.schedule_item_id, a.index_order, a.back_number, a.match_id, a.game_item_id, a.sport_limit, a.works_name, a.works_music, a.works_music_name, a.works_video, a.create_time, a.update_time, b.id as sub_id, b.match_id as sub_match_id, b.sport_id as sub_sport_id, b.sign_record_id as sub_sign_record_id, cc.player_name, cc.id_card, cc.sex from jw_sign_record a left join jw_sign_record_sport b on b.sign_record_id = a.id left join jw_sport cc on cc.id = b.sport_id where a.team_id = #{teamId} and a.match_id = #{matchId}

select a.id, a.team_id, a.schedule_item_id, a.index_order, a.back_number, a.match_id, a.game_item_id, a.sport_limit, a.works_name, a.works_music, a.works_music_name, a.works_video, a.create_time, a.update_time, b.id as sub_id, b.match_id as sub_match_id, b.sport_id as sub_sport_id, b.sign_record_id as sub_sign_record_id from jw_sign_record a left join jw_sign_record_sport b on b.sign_record_id = a.id left join jw_match_team jmt on jmt.team_id = a.team_id where a.match_id = #{matchId} order by jmt.index_order

select a.id, a.team_id, jt.team_name, a.schedule_item_id, a.index_order, a.back_number, a.match_id, a.game_item_id, a.sport_limit, a.works_name, a.works_music, a.works_music_name, a.works_video, b.id as sub_id, b.match_id as sub_match_id, b.sport_id as sub_sport_id, b.sign_record_id as sub_sign_record_id, cc.player_name, cc.id_card, cc.sex, jt.id as sub_team_id, jsi.item_name, jsii.schedule_name, jsp.place_order, jsi.area, jsp.place_time from jw_sign_record a left join jw_team jt on jt.id = a.team_id left join jw_sign_record_sport b on b.sign_record_id = a.id left join jw_sport cc on cc.id = b.sport_id left join jw_schedule_item jsi on jsi.id = a.schedule_item_id left join jw_schedule_info jsii on jsii.id = jsi.schedule_info_id left join jw_schedule_place jsp on jsp.id = jsi.schedule_place_id where a.schedule_item_id is not null and a.team_id = #{teamId} and a.match_id = #{matchId} order by jsii.index_order asc, jsp.place_order asc,jsi.area asc, a.index_order asc

select a.* from jw_sign_record a left join jw_sign_record_sport b on b.sign_record_id = a.id where b.sport_id = #{sportId} and a.match_id = #{matchId} and a.sport_limit = '1' and a.back_number is not null
select a.back_number from jw_sign_record a where a.match_id = #{matchId} and a.back_number is not null order by a.back_number desc limit 1

select a.id, a.team_id, a.schedule_item_id, a.index_order, a.back_number, a.show_img, a.match_id, a.game_item_id, a.sport_limit, a.works_name, a.works_music, a.works_music_name, a.works_video, b.id as sub_id, b.match_id as sub_match_id, b.sport_id as sub_sport_id, b.sign_record_id as sub_sign_record_id, cc.player_name, cc.id_card, cc.sex, jsi.item_name, jsii.schedule_name, jsp.place_order, jsi.area, jsp.place_time from jw_sign_record a left join jw_sign_record_sport b on b.sign_record_id = a.id left join jw_sport cc on cc.id = b.sport_id left join jw_schedule_item jsi on jsi.id = a.schedule_item_id left join jw_schedule_info jsii on jsii.id = jsi.schedule_info_id left join jw_schedule_place jsp on jsp.id = jsi.schedule_place_id where a.schedule_item_id is not null and a.match_id = #{matchId} and a.back_number = #{backNumber} order by jsii.index_order asc, jsp.place_order asc,jsi.area asc, a.index_order asc

select a.id, a.team_id, a.schedule_item_id, a.show_img, a.index_order, a.back_number, a.match_id, a.game_item_id, a.sport_limit, a.works_name, a.works_music, a.works_music_name, a.works_video, a.create_time, a.update_time, b.id as sub_id, b.match_id as sub_match_id, b.sport_id as sub_sport_id, b.sign_record_id as sub_sign_record_id, cc.player_name, cc.id_card, cc.sex, jgi.id as game_item_id, jgi.match_id, jgi.code as game_item_code, jgi.name as game_item_name, jgi.fee as game_item_fee from jw_sign_record a left join jw_sign_record_sport b on b.sign_record_id = a.id left join jw_sport cc on cc.id = b.sport_id left join jw_game_item jgi on jgi.id = a.game_item_id where a.team_id = #{teamId} and a.match_id = #{matchId} and (a.sport_limit = 3 or a.match_id = 12 or a.match_id = 13)
select COUNT(DISTINCT sport_id ) as count from jw_sign_record_sport where team_id = #{teamId} and match_id = #{matchId}
select COUNT( sport_id ) as count from jw_sign_record_sport where team_id = #{teamId} and match_id = #{matchId}

mapper.update: update jw_sign_record set game_item_id = #{changeGameItemId}, schedule_item_id = null where id = #{id}; update jw_sign_record_sport set game_item_id = #{changeGameItemId} where sign_record_id = #{id};
update jw_sign_record set all_score = null, avg_score = null, rank_order = null where game_item_id = #{gameItemId}
update jw_sign_record set back_number = null where match_id = #{matchId}
update jw_sign_record set rank_order = #{rankOrder} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select jsr.* from jw_sign_record jsr left join jw_game_item gi on gi.id = jsr.game_item_id where game_item_id = #{gameItemId} and jsr.rank_order <= gi.promotion_num order by jsr.rank_order asc
